scientificMeaning.finding: Modern a is the positive-voltage/positive-current forward characteristic. Modern b shows small but nonzero negative reverse current at negative voltage, approaching zero at the junction of the axes. Modern c combines those signs and trends continuously through the origin. The finite reverse branches stay within the prose's expressly limited non-breakdown regime. No measured scale or breakdown threshold is invented; the complete bilingual warning prevents reading the sketches as comparable measured current magnitudes. These are current-voltage characteristics, not current-versus-time rectification waveforms.
